#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

int n;
vector<long long> occ;
vector<long long> nbr_vertexes;
const long long big = 1000000007;

void count_vertexes() {
    occ[0]++;
    nbr_vertexes[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        vector<long long> oc(n / 2 + 1, 0);
        int limite = min(n - i, n / 2);
        for (int j = 0; j <= limite; j++) {
            long long h = occ[j];
            if (j + 1 <= limite) {
                oc[j + 1] += h;
                oc[j + 1] %= big;
            }
            if (j - 1 >= 0) {
                oc[j - 1] += h;
                oc[j - 1] %= big;
            }
            oc[j] %= big;
        }
        if (limite + 1 <= n / 2) {
            oc[limite] += occ[limite + 1];
            oc[limite] %= big;
        }
        long long sum = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j <= limite; j++) {
            sum += oc[j];
            occ[j] = oc[j];
            sum %= big;
        }
        nbr_vertexes[i] = sum;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int input_n;
    cin >> input_n;
    n = 2 * input_n;
    occ.assign(n / 2 + 1, 0);
    nbr_vertexes.assign(n + 1, 0);
    long long res1 = 0;
    long long res2 = 0;
    count_vertexes();
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
        res1 += nbr_vertexes[i];
        res1 %= big;
    }
    for (int i = n - 2; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
        res2 += nbr_vertexes[i];
        res2 %= big;
    }
    cout << res1 << "\n";
    return 0;
}
